name: kg_update_node
description:
kg_update_node: Updates an existing node in the knowledge graph.

**Purpose:** Modify properties of an existing node (label, description, dates, confidence, etc.)

**Parameters:**
- node_id (required): UUID of the node to update
- label (optional): New label for the node
- semantic_label (optional): New semantic label for the node (descriptive with names in parentheses)
- description (optional): New description for the node
- aliases (optional): List of aliases to add/update
- category (optional): Category of the node
- start_date (optional): Start date in YYYY-MM-DD format
- end_date (optional): End date in YYYY-MM-DD format
- start_date_confidence (optional): Confidence in start date ('actual', 'inferred')
- end_date_confidence (optional): Confidence in end date ('actual', 'inferred')
- valid_during (optional): Indicates the qualitative period of validness


**Returns:**
- success: Whether the operation succeeded
- node_id: UUID of the updated node
- label: Current label of the node
- node_type: Type of the node
- updated_fields: List of fields that were changed
- message: Description of what was done

**Safety:** This is a low-risk operation. You can safely update node properties without confirmation.
arguments_prompt:
Arguments for kg_update_node:

node_id (required): The UUID of the node you want to update
label (optional): New label for the node
semantic_label (optional): New semantic label for the node (descriptive with names in parentheses)
description (optional): New description for the node
aliases (optional): List of aliases to add/update
category (optional): category of the node
attributes (optional): Dictionary of attributes to merge
start_date (optional): Start date in YYYY-MM-DD format
end_date (optional): End date in YYYY-MM-DD format
start_date_confidence (optional): Confidence in start date ('actual', 'inferred')
end_date_confidence (optional): Confidence in end date ('actual', 'inferred')
valid_during (optional): Indicates the qualitative period of validness. eg. last few years, currently valid etc.

You only need to update the parameters that you are provided.
